question: Buy iPhone? (budget 40k, salary 28k, old phone works)

box_1_flrrc.fact: iPhone budget 40k, salary 28k, old phone works fine
box_1_flrrc.logic: 40k is more than one month salary, and the old phone still does the job
box_1_flrrc.reasoning: A want, not a need. Saving the 40k protects the budget for a real need later
box_1_flrrc.representation: Decision matrix: Want satisfaction vs Utility vs Money strain
box_1_flrrc.conclusion: Keep the old phone, save the money

box_2_equation.regret_probability: Buy chesi 55% regret (EMI and tight month), keep chesi 20% regret (want)

box_3_graph: Bar chart: Go -0.3 vs NoGo 2.6. Money strain makes buying weak

box_4_risk.best: 40k saved and a phone upgrade when it really fails
box_4_risk.worst: EMI burden and no savings for emergencies
box_4_risk.middle: Set a 3 month goal to save 20k first and buy a cheaper model if you still want one
